fbd22b1945533f1132b1aaf3815357e45c2f4d06.pinyin: tā jié rán yì shēn lái dào mò shēng de chéng shì.
fbd22b1945533f1132b1aaf3815357e45c2f4d06.text: 他孑然一身来到陌生的城市。

fbd25ead5973ab560e8b42fb4db257879ebad328.pinyin: méi néng jiàn dào lǎo yǒu, tā hěn yí hàn.
fbd25ead5973ab560e8b42fb4db257879ebad328.text: 没能见到老友，她很遗憾。

fbd7d1a6d98a81a74c1d821c60f03e820a830324.pinyin: tā jiǔ jià bèi dài zhe le.

fbd8f8e9ed69d23988892d77dc95313acc685700.pinyin: zhè ge xiāo xi bù tài kě xìn.

fbd8fe4c79ed8439915a1c42dbf8e5fb1112b35a.pinyin: zhè fèn jì huà shí fēn zhěn mì.

fbdaec795f7ede8555804f1314899fdcfc2c9e2f.pinyin: zhēng shuì biāo zhǔn xū yào gōng kāi.

fbdb889c8e558fe7e4d3e84f1b19b19d50191865.pinyin: wǒ zài wǎng shàng mǎi le yì běn shū.

fbdd848e787f45c57f5b401aa6cbd8dd9f25a788.pinyin: tā zhòng de niǎo luó kāi chū le xiǎo hóng huā.
fbdd848e787f45c57f5b401aa6cbd8dd9f25a788.text: 她种的茑萝开出了小红花。

fbde12076fec0395ffc63290056b7184bef05a55.pinyin: zhè ge bǎo bao xiào qǐ lai hěn kě ài.
fbde12076fec0395ffc63290056b7184bef05a55.text: 这个宝宝笑起来很可爱。

fbe639797f7f1ff6a18f512a68c7b964b460ea0f.pinyin: xiǎo chuán xú xú shǐ lí àn biān.

fbeaa32a35aeb10f8e17a4fd28f4634746d5fc7b.pinyin: yī zhī yàn zi cóng shuǐ miàn shàng lüè guò.
fbeaa32a35aeb10f8e17a4fd28f4634746d5fc7b.text: 一只燕子从水面上掠过。

fbf295fecaae5fede3d76113684513c081e6c126.pinyin: tā wéi rén dūn hòu, yuàn yì bāng zhù yǒu kùn nan de rén.
fbf295fecaae5fede3d76113684513c081e6c126.text: 他为人惇厚，愿意帮助有困难的人。

fbf87d298ee320a579a5ea71da7e904ebd5aa5ec.pinyin: kàn dào nà zhāng zhào piàn, tā bù yóu zì zhǔ de xiào le.
fbf87d298ee320a579a5ea71da7e904ebd5aa5ec.text: 看到那张照片，她不由自主地笑了。

fbf8835afb5a87981394fbfc2323057f73dfeee1.pinyin: lǚ xíng jié shù hòu, tā bǎ suǒ jiàn suǒ wén xiě jìn rì jì.
fbf8835afb5a87981394fbfc2323057f73dfeee1.text: 旅行结束后，他把所见所闻写进日记。
